rules.reason: The player's device could not resolve the host. Roblox web APIs fail this way on a bad connection
The connection could not be established from the player's device
The request timed out on the player's connection. Roblox prints Timedout on some paths and TimedOut on others
Network-level failure on the player's device
The client aborted the request before it completed
The connection was closed mid-request by the remote side
No data arrived for long enough that the client gave up
The TLS handshake failed on the player's device
Certificate verification failed, usually a captive portal or a player-side proxy
The remote sent a response the client could not parse
The player left while a yielding group or rank lookup was in flight. The engine raises after the fact, so the game cannot prevent it

rules.match: Character cannot be changed as Player
rules.reason: The engine raises this when a character load races a player leaving

rules.match: DataStore request was added to queue
rules.reason: Roblox throttled a DataStore call and queued it. Batch requests to reduce it; queue depth is not actionable per event
Roblox CoreGui emits this on some client builds, including sessions that use no StyleLinks
The same engine warning under a parent other than RobloxGui, which CoreGui also emits on some builds
Selection warning that also fires from CoreGui, and from objects that exist but are not valid selection targets yet
The engine prints this once a WaitForChild passes five seconds. Cosmetic effects and optional events wait on parts that may never arrive

rules.match: MarketplaceService::getProductInfo - GetGamePassInfo failed: HTTP request failed
rules.reason: The marketplace backend failed a game pass lookup. Roblox-side, transient

rules.match: MarketplaceService::getProductInfo - GetDeveloperProductInfo failed: HTTP request failed
rules.reason: The marketplace backend failed a developer product lookup, either a server error or a dropped connection
A generic engine-internal failure, usually a DataStore or engine backend call. It surfaces inside the calling handler and has no game-side cause
The engine caps AnimationTracks at 64 per Animator. Tracks are leaked somewhere, but the warning itself is not actionable per event
Rayfield is an exploit-script UI library. Its banner reaches LogService from the executor's own environment, which no game script can intercept
LocalizationService could not load a locale table for the player's locale. Engine-side, and no game script can supply the missing table
MessagingService drops its subscription and surfaces the bare string reconnecting. Engine-side, and libraries such as ProfileStore retry on their own
The Roblox group backend returned a 5xx for IsInGroup or GetRankInGroup. Roblox-side and transient, the same shape as the marketplace rules

rules.match: Publishing the game is required to use GetTranslatorForPlayerAsync API
rules.reason: LocalizationService refuses to build a translator for a place that has never been published. Engine-side, not game code

rules.match: Something unexpectedly tried to set the parent of
rules.reason: Engine lifecycle race when a ChildAdded or DescendantAdded handler reparents or destroys the instance. CoreGui emits it too and it is not actionable
